task.title: Record and design the development-tooling architecture corrections

scope.owned_layer: Development tooling architecture gap analysis and design specification for supervisor, V2 TaskStore, and auto-workers

gap_architecture_designs.immutable_task_correction: Append-only TaskAmendedEvent in TaskStore journal preserves full event history while enabling effective task spec corrections under governed amendment authority.
gap_architecture_designs.dependency_aware_reopen: DAG dependency recalculation on reopen combined with structured RootEvidenceHandoff contracts.
gap_architecture_designs.artifact_ownership_overlap: Explicit artifacts_manifest (owned_write_paths, referenced_read_paths) with supervisor path-overlap mutual exclusion gating extending existing artifact_conflict_guard.
gap_architecture_designs.cross_repo_sidecars: First-class target_repo, task_nature, parent_task_id, and subphase fields integrated with multi_repo_registry.py.
gap_architecture_designs.exact_head_rejection_recovery: Pure lifecycle supersede exit for closed/merged PR heads and deterministic waiting_for cleanup on state transitions.
